title: Missing #[non_exhaustive] on SchcError enum
description:
Location: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/error.rs line 43

The public error enum `SchcError` lacks `#[non_exhaustive]`:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SchcError {
    BufferTooSmall(BufferTooSmall),
    TooShort(TooShort),
    InvalidRule,
    InvalidField,
    CompressionFailed,
    FragmentError,
}
```

What goes wrong: Adding a new error variant is a semver-breaking change because downstream code can have exhaustive match statements. The sibling enum `FragmentError` in wire.rs correctly uses `#[non_exhaustive]`.

Fix: Add `#[non_exhaustive]` to the enum definition.
